title: On Examining the wall inch by inch
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：examine　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 examine 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the father ① examined the wall inch by inch without complaint, and every neighbour in the house said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the father ② examines the wall inch by inch with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ examine the wall inch by inch at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ examined the wall inch by inch before — a line in the letter for September 1949 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Examining the wall inch by inch without complaint, the father said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the chair at the far door, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ examine the boys in Latin only with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Examine the boys in Latin only at once and never mention it again.

By 1962 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the letter, and a new neighbour from the next house ⑧ examines the boys in Latin only without complaint every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the door, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ examined the wall inch by inch again when nobody else would.

⑩ To examine the wall inch by inch, my mother said in 1967, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the house remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the house forgets, somebody examines the wall inch by inch with great care again and somebody must examine the wall inch by inch without complaint all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 检查（一般过去式 examined the wall inch by inch：1955 年父亲头一回这样做，毫无怨言地）
B. v. 检查（一般现在 examines the wall inch by inch：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 检查（不定式 to examine the wall inch by inch：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 检查（过去完成时 had examined the wall inch by inch：1949 年九月的家书上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 检查（动名词 examining the wall inch by inch 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 考查（examine the boys in Latin only：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去考查只考孩子们拉丁文）
G. v. 考查（examine the boys in Latin only：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 检查（后段两处：新来的邻居照例 examines the boys in Latin only，而母亲又一次 examined the wall inch by inch）

answers.why: examine 意为“检查”，1955 年父亲毫无怨言地检查把那道墙一寸寸看过，那是老屋里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 examined。
examine 意为“检查”，自那以后父亲小心翼翼地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 examines。
examine 意为“检查”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯检查把那道墙一寸寸看过”，此处为不定式 to examine the wall inch by inch。
examine 意为“检查”，家书里 九月 那行字说明早在 1962 年之前就有人检查过，故用过去完成时 had examined。
examine 意为“检查”，父亲说“检查把那道墙一寸寸看过这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 examining the wall inch by inch 作主语。
examine 意为“考查”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去考查只考孩子们拉丁文”，should ever 之后用原形 examine the boys in Latin only。
examine 意为“考查”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻考查只考孩子们拉丁文（examine the boys in Latin only at once），以后再也不要提起。
examine 意为“检查”，新来的邻居每个月份都照例考查只考孩子们拉丁文，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 examines。
examine 意为“检查”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次毫无怨言地检查把那道墙一寸寸看过，用一般过去式 examined 叙述。
examine 意为“检查”，结尾那句是母亲 1967 年的话：要检查把那道墙一寸寸看过，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和老屋记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 examine 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1955 the father examined the wall inch by inch without complaint, and nobody in the house forgot it.
Even now the father examines the wall inch by inch with great care whenever the house asks.
Examining the wall inch by inch without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever examine the boys in Latin only with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new neighbour from the next house examines the boys in Latin only without complaint every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother examined the wall inch by inch again, and the house remembered that half.
